scope: Read-only independent review of final test derivatives, every changed rectangle, six complete cover pairs and the adapter validation logic. No proof audit, scientific recomputation, or PDF mutation.

visual_coverage.review_method: All 150 before/after strips were inspected at native 2x glyph rendering through thirteen contact sheets. After the duplication fix, all strips were regenerated from immutable raw inputs: 144 strips were byte-identical to the reviewed pass; the six changed strips and three changed full cover pairs were inspected again.

visual_findings: No visible white patch, pale-background discontinuity, clipping, overlap, missing glyph, baseline defect, or unexpected position change.
III analytic branding remains centered; original font sizes, colors and alignment are retained elsewhere.
Combined old/new branding lines are deduplicated correctly. Historical PAPER III / RELEASE 1.0.0 footer suffix remains intact.

Six separate-line duplicate cover cases were detected during independent review and repaired by deleting only the old top brand, leaving the original lower REALIZATION CALCULUS label and all remaining positions unchanged.

resolved_issue.resolution: Remove old top branding without replacement when exact existing series label follows nearby.
resolved_issue.reviewed_current_result: Clean single upper series label; pale and white page backgrounds preserved.

validation_logic_review: Atomic replacement leaves original file untouched on validation failure.
Text-only redaction disables image and vector removal and adds no background fill.
Unknown fonts, rotated labels, mixed styles, page overflow and text overlap fail explicitly.
All non-branding text is normalized and compared; original page count, labels, links, bookmarks, named destinations and images are checked.
Vector structure is preserved with explicit 0.0001-point numeric-reserialization tolerance; every changed page additionally requires zero changed rendered pixels outside branding at 144 dpi.
Full end-to-end monograph integration is outside this component-only review.

reviewed_inherited_diagnostics.finding: The owner separately read/rendered immutable inputs and recorded pre-existing XI zero ascent/descent metrics and three unreferenced IV object slots (zero references). These are inherited diagnostics, not newly introduced content failures; the independently reviewed final renders are clean.
